issues.on_page: General Fund Other 9,104 (p6); Depreciation Other 10,604; total 19,708
issues.issue: Amount 19,708 is correct, but the review note's breakdown is wrong: p6 prints General Fund 'Other' as 9,104 (= p10 '1990 Other' 9,084 + '1910 Rental of school equipment' 20). 9,084 + 10,604 = 19,688, not 19,708. Only the note text is wrong.

issues.on_page: Facilities 450,000 disbursement in General Fund (p6/p10), eliminated (450,000) against Depreciation 'Transfer from other funds' in the Eliminations column (p7)
issues.issue: Extractor's assumption: the whole printed disbursement line is reclassified as an interfund transfer, using split_from even though nothing is split. This matches the elimination on p7 and is already marked review. detail_totals[1] (13,132,507, includes other financing) only ties if the validator adds the absolute values of the signed -450,000 and -65,000 lines.

On p2 the auditor counts this 33,361 in Instruction operating grants and contributions (1,613,005 + 31,727 + 33,361 + 841 = 1,678,934), so it may include grants from governments. The category is defensible and already marked review. The same applies to receipts[15] (75,361).
